normalization_plan.reason: punkIndex is a pure input selector for buyPunk and has no independent security meaning outside that function
amount is only a snapshot of pendingWithdrawals inside withdraw and collapses into the function's reentrancy behaviour
tokenId is produced and consumed entirely inside _redeemPunk and is covered by that core function
to is the arbitrary destination of the balance transfer in Profitable.withdraw
randomIndex is the getPseudoRand output used for selection inside _redeemPunk
tokenIds only parameterizes the batch deposit loop of _mintPunkMultiple
fee is the getFee result compared against msg.value inside mintPunk
recipient is the untrusted call target of Address.sendValue
bid pointer is read and cleared within transferPunk's bid-revault logic
